name: resolve-error-code
description: Resolve a displayed appliance error code to its deterministic meaning using the banked Error-Code Dataset V1. Manufacturer-agnostic. Returns RESOLVED, NEEDS_CONTEXT, AMBIGUOUS, NOT_FOUND or INVALID_INPUT. No LLM, no RAG, no guessing.

make.description: Appliance brand, for example Bosch, Siemens, Hotpoint or LG.

appliance.description: Canonical appliance type, for example washing-machine, dishwasher, fridge-freezer.

code.description: The code exactly as displayed where possible, for example E15, F06, i20, F8E4 or E:61-03.

observed.description: Optional observed product/rating-plate identifiers used when code meaning depends on scheme, platform or generation.

region.description: Optional market/region, for example UK, EU or NA.
